blurb.en: plt.plot, plt.xlabel, plt.title and plt.legend never say which graph they mean - they all draw on pyplot's current figure.
blurb.zh: plt.plot、plt.xlabel、plt.title、plt.legend 从不说画在哪张图上——它们都画在 pyplot 的「当前图」上。

en: pyplot keeps a hidden current figure, and inside it current axes. plt.figure starts a new figure and makes it current; every later plt call draws on whatever is current at that moment. Nothing is passed from one call to the next, which is why draw_week can return nothing at all.

The picture: two lines across the five weekdays Mon to Fri - Leeds at 9, 11, 10, 13, 12 degrees and York at 8, 10, 12, 12, 14. The x axis is named Day, the y axis Temperature (C), the title is Midday temperature, and a legend in a corner names the two lines using the label given to each plot call. Because the x values are strings, matplotlib puts the five day names along the axis in the order they appear.

The demo cannot be handed the axes, so it asks pyplot for the current ones afterwards and reads the facts back: 2 lines, the two axis names and the title, a legend with Leeds and York, the ticks Mon to Fri, and that week-pyplot.png now exists. After plt.close no figures are left open. Closing matters: pyplot keeps every figure alive until it is closed, so a loop that draws many graphs without closing them keeps using more memory.
The file is written into the folder the program runs from. To see the graph in a window instead, call plt.show() before closing - in PyCharm that opens the picture and waits until you shut it.
The same graph drawn through objects is 「Line Graph with Figure and Axes」; put the two side by side to see which lines change.
zh: pyplot 暗中记着一张「当前图」，图里还有「当前坐标系」。plt.figure 新建一张图并把它设为当前；之后每一个 plt 调用，都画在那一刻的当前图上。调用之间什么也不传，所以 draw_week 可以什么都不交回。

画出来的样子：横轴是 Mon 到 Fri 五个工作日，两条折线——Leeds 是 9、11、10、13、12 度，York 是 8、10、12、12、14 度。横轴名叫 Day，纵轴名叫 Temperature (C)，标题是 Midday temperature，角上的图例用每次 plot 时给的 label 标出两条线。横坐标是字符串，matplotlib 就按出现的顺序把五个星期名排在轴上。
演示块拿不到坐标系，只好事后向 pyplot 要当前的那个，再把事实读回来：2 条线、两个轴名和标题、图例里是 Leeds 和 York、刻度是 Mon 到 Fri、week-pyplot.png 确实存在。plt.close 之后一张打开的图都不剩。关图很要紧：pyplot 会让每张图一直活着直到关掉，循环里画很多图却不关，占的内存就一直涨。
文件写在程序运行的那个文件夹里。想在窗口里看到这张图，就在关图之前调用 plt.show()——在 PyCharm 里它会弹出图片，等你关掉窗口才往下走。
同一张图用对象来画，见「折线图：Figure 与 Axes 对象写法」；两个并排对照，就能看出哪几行变了。

lineNotes.en: Starts a new, empty figure and makes it the current one - every plt call below lands on it.
lineNotes.zh: 新建一张空图并设为当前图——下面每个 plt 调用都落在它上面。

lineNotes.en: With no argument, closes the current figure.
lineNotes.zh: 不带实参时，关掉的是当前图。

x label: Day
y label: Temperature (C)
title: Midday temperature
legend: ['Leeds', 'York']
x ticks: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']

title.en: Line Graph with Figure and Axes
title.zh: 折线图：Figure 与 Axes 对象写法

blurb.en: The same graph, but plt.subplots hands you the figure and its axes as objects, and every call names the one it draws on.
blurb.zh: 同一张图，但 plt.subplots 把图和坐标系作为对象交到你手里，每个调用都点名画在哪一个上。

en: plt.subplots makes two objects at once: fig, the whole picture (the thing that gets saved), and ax, one set of axes - the plotting area together with its ticks, axis names and title. From there on every call says which object it acts on: ax.plot, ax.legend, fig.savefig.

Some names change on the way from pyplot: plt.xlabel becomes ax.set_xlabel, plt.ylabel becomes ax.set_ylabel and plt.title becomes ax.set_title, while plot and legend keep their names. The picture is exactly the one in 「Line Graph the pyplot Way」: Leeds and York across Mon to Fri, the axes named Day and Temperature (C), the title Midday temperature, and a legend for the two lines.

Why bother? With several figures, or several axes in one figure, the current one is simply whichever was touched last, and it is easy to draw on the wrong one. Here draw_week hands back fig and ax, so the caller can check them and close exactly that figure - afterwards no figures are left open.
A rule of thumb: the pyplot way for a quick one-off graph, the object way inside functions and for anything with more than one set of axes. The rest of this page uses the object way.
zh: plt.subplots 一次造出两个对象：fig 是整张图（存成文件的就是它），ax 是一个坐标系——画图区连同它的刻度、轴名和标题。从这里起，每个调用都说明作用在哪个对象上：ax.plot、ax.legend、fig.savefig。

从 pyplot 换过来，有几个名字变了：plt.xlabel 变成 ax.set_xlabel，plt.ylabel 变成 ax.set_ylabel，plt.title 变成 ax.set_title；plot 和 legend 名字不变。画出来的图与「折线图：pyplot 写法」一模一样：Leeds 和 York 两条线横跨 Mon 到 Fri，两个轴名是 Day 和 Temperature (C)，标题 Midday temperature，图例标出两条线。
何必多此一举？图不止一张、或者一张图里有好几个坐标系时，「当前」的就是最后碰过的那个，很容易画错地方。这里 draw_week 把 fig 和 ax 交回去，调用方可以查它们、也能准确地关掉这一张——关完之后一张打开的图都不剩。
经验法则：随手画一张用 pyplot 写法；写在函数里、或者有不止一个坐标系时用对象写法。本页其余的程序都用对象写法。

lineNotes.en: Handing both objects back lets the caller read facts from ax and close exactly this fig.
lineNotes.zh: 把两个对象都交回去，调用方就能从 ax 读事实、并准确地关掉这一张 fig。

lineNotes.en: Closes this figure by name, whatever happens to be current.
lineNotes.zh: 按名字关掉这一张，不管当前图是哪张。

title.en: Scatter Plot with Sizes and Colours
title.zh: 散点图：点的大小与颜色

blurb.en: Six pupils as six dots: hours revised across, score up, the dot's size for past papers done and its colour for attendance.
blurb.zh: 六个学生六个点：横轴是复习小时数，纵轴是分数，点的大小表示做过的真题数，颜色表示出勤率。

en: ax.scatter draws one dot for each (x, y) pair, and nothing joins them. Here x is hours revised and y is the test score, so the six dots run from the pupil who revised 1 hour and scored 41 up to the one who revised 8 hours and scored 83.

s sets each dot's area, measured in points squared, and it can be a list with one size per dot. The sizes are 40 plus 60 for every past paper, so they go from 40 (no papers) to 340 (five papers). It is the area, not the width: a dot with four times the s looks twice as wide.

c gives each dot a number, and the colour map viridis turns the smallest (an attendance of 70) into dark purple and the largest (99) into yellow, with blue and green between. fig.colorbar adds the key - a coloured strip down the right-hand side labelled Attendance (%). The strip is an axes of its own, which is why the figure now holds 2 axes, and its label is that axes' y label.

The object ax.scatter hands back holds all six dots together. The demo reads back the positions (an array of 6 rows and 2 columns), so x runs from 1 to 8 and y from 41 to 83; the sizes 100, 220, 40, 340, 280, 160; and the colour values, which come back as floats. Picking out a column with xy[:, 0] is numpy slicing, covered in 「NumPy Basics」.
zh: ax.scatter 为每一对 (x, y) 画一个点，点与点之间不连线。这里 x 是复习小时数，y 是测验分数，六个点从「复习 1 小时、得 41 分」的学生一直到「复习 8 小时、得 83 分」的那个。
s 定每个点的面积，单位是「点」的平方，可以给一个列表、每个点一个大小。这里大小是 40 再加上每做一套真题 60，所以从 40（一套没做）到 340（做了五套）。它是面积不是宽度：s 是四倍的点，看上去只宽两倍。
c 给每个点一个数，配色表 viridis 把最小的（出勤率 70）变成深紫、最大的（99）变成黄，中间是蓝和绿。fig.colorbar 加上图例——右边一条竖着的色带，标着 Attendance (%)。色带自己也是一个坐标系，所以这张图现在有 2 个坐标系，它的标签就是那个坐标系的纵轴名。
ax.scatter 交回的对象把六个点装在一起。演示块读回它们的位置（一个 6 行 2 列的数组），横坐标从 1 到 8、纵坐标从 41 到 83；大小是 100、220、40、340、280、160；颜色值读回来是浮点数。用 xy[:, 0] 取出一列是 numpy 的切片，见「NumPy 基础」。

lineNotes.at: sizes = [40 + 60 * p for p in PAPERS]
lineNotes.en: One size per dot: a pupil with no past papers still gets a visible dot of 40.
lineNotes.zh: 每个点一个大小：一套真题都没做的学生也有一个看得见的 40。

lineNotes.en: fig.axes[0] is the scatter itself; the colour bar was added second.
lineNotes.zh: fig.axes[0] 是散点图本身；色带是后加的第二个。

blurb.en: Four clubs as upright bars with the member count written on top of each, then the same data as sideways bars, shortest first.
blurb.zh: 四个社团画成竖柱，每根柱顶写上人数；再把同样的数据画成横柱，从少到多排。

en: ax.bar takes the bar names and the bar heights. String names go along the x axis as ticks in the order given - Chess, Coding, Drama, Robotics - and the heights are the member counts 12, 18, 9 and 15. What it hands back is a container of the four rectangles; ax.patches lists the same rectangles, which is how the demo reads their heights.
ax.bar_label writes each bar's value just above it and hands back the text objects it made, so the labels read 12, 18, 9 and 15 - as strings, because they are text on the picture.

get_height gives back a numpy number, and numpy 2 would print a list of them as np.int64(12) and so on; float turns each into an ordinary Python float first, so the heights print as 12.0, 18.0, 9.0 and 15.0 (the numpy side of this is in 「NumPy Basics」).

For sideways bars, ax.barh takes the names and the lengths. Now the value is each bar's width, and its height is only its thickness - 0.8 for every bar, the default. barh puts the first item at the bottom, so after sorting the chart reads from the bottom up Drama 9, Chess 12, Robotics 15, Coding 18. Long names fit better written sideways.
Sorting the (count, name) pairs puts them in order of count because tuples are compared item by item, first items first (see 「Sorting」); zip is in 「Comprehensions & Built-ins」.
zh: ax.bar 收柱子的名字和柱子的高度。字符串名字按给定的顺序排在横轴上当刻度——Chess、Coding、Drama、Robotics，高度就是人数 12、18、9、15。它交回一个装着四个长方形的容器；ax.patches 列出的也是这四个长方形，演示块就是从它读高度的。
ax.bar_label 在每根柱子正上方写上它的数值，交回它造的那些文字对象，所以标签读出来是 12、18、9、15——是字符串，因为它们是画在图上的文字。
get_height 交回的是 numpy 的数，numpy 2 打印一列这样的数会印成 np.int64(12) 之类；float 先把每个变成普通的 Python 浮点数，所以高度打印成 12.0、18.0、9.0、15.0（numpy 这一面见「NumPy 基础」）。
横柱用 ax.barh，收名字和长度。这时数值是每根柱子的宽度，高度只是它的粗细——每根都是缺省的 0.8。barh 把第一项放在最下面，所以排好序之后从下往上读是 Drama 9、Chess 12、Robotics 15、Coding 18。名字长的时候横着写更放得下。
给 (人数, 名字) 对排序会按人数排，因为元组逐项比较、先比第一项（见「排序」）；zip 见「推导式与内置函数」。

lineNotes.at: ax.barh([name for _, name in pairs], [count for count, _ in pairs])
lineNotes.en: Splits the sorted pairs back into the names and the lengths, keeping their new order.
lineNotes.zh: 把排好序的对拆回名字和长度两列，保持新的顺序。

lineNotes.en: For barh the value is each bar's width; the heights printed next are only the thickness, 0.8 each.
lineNotes.zh: 对 barh 来说数值是每根柱子的宽度；下一行打印的高只是粗细，每根 0.8。

run.expect:
bars: 4
heights: [12.0, 18.0, 9.0, 15.0]
ticks: ['Chess', 'Coding', 'Drama', 'Robotics']
labels on bars: ['12', '18', '9', '15']
widths: [9.0, 12.0, 15.0, 18.0]
heights: [0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8]
ticks: ['Drama', 'Chess', 'Robotics', 'Coding']

blurb.en: Split 0 to 100 into five equal bins and count the values in each - a value on an edge goes into the bin on its right, except at the very top.
blurb.zh: 把 0 到 100 分成五个等宽的箱，数每个箱里有几个值——落在边界上的值归右边的箱，只有最顶端例外。

en: A histogram splits a range into equal bins and counts how many values land in each. Here 0 to 100 is split into 5 bins of width 20, so the edges are 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100.

The edge rule: every bin includes its left edge but not its right one - 20 goes into the bin from 20 to 40, 19 into the bin before - except the last bin, which includes both ends, so 100 is counted in the bin from 80 to 100. Values below the range or above it are not counted at all. The first two demo lines show this: 0 and 19 land in the first bin, 20 in the second, 99 and 100 both in the last, giving 2, 1, 0, 0, 2; and with -5 and 105 outside the range, only 0 and 100 are counted, giving 1, 0, 0, 0, 1.

histogram_counts asks numpy's histogram function - the same counting ax.hist does - and turns its counts into a plain list of Python ints before returning them. It uses numpy's function rather than ax.hist because it only wants the numbers: ax.hist would also draw bars into a figure on every call, and nothing here needs a picture.

The marks come from rng = np.random.default_rng with a fixed seed: a generator object whose seed makes the same numbers come out on every run. That is the only way numpy random numbers are made on these pages. integers(0, 101, size=40) gives 40 whole marks from 0 to 100 (the upper bound 101 itself is never drawn), and one extra 100 is added on the end so the top-edge rule has something to show. With this seed the five bins hold 8, 8, 10, 9 and 6 marks, 41 in all; a different seed gives different counts.

ax.hist does the counting and the drawing in one call and hands back three things: the counts, the edges, and the bars it drew. Its counts are floats - 8.0, 8.0, 10.0, 9.0, 6.0 - because the same function can also count with weights or as proportions; otherwise they agree with histogram_counts. The picture is five bars standing edge to edge from 0 to 100, the tallest being the middle bin from 40 to 60. To see the plot in a window, call plt.show() before plt.close.
zh: 直方图把一个范围切成等宽的箱，数每个箱里落了几个值。这里把 0 到 100 切成 5 个宽 20 的箱，边界是 0、20、40、60、80、100。
边界规则：每个箱含左边界、不含右边界——20 进 20 到 40 那一箱，19 进前一箱——只有最后一箱两头都含，所以 100 算在 80 到 100 那一箱里。比范围小或比范围大的值根本不算。演示块头两行就是在演示它：0 和 19 落在第一箱，20 在第二箱，99 和 100 都在最后一箱，得 2、1、0、0、2；-5 和 105 在范围外，只数到 0 和 100，得 1、0、0、0、1。
histogram_counts 请 numpy 的 histogram 函数来数——ax.hist 内部用的就是这套计数——交回之前把计数变成装着 Python 整数的普通列表。它用 numpy 的函数而不用 ax.hist，是因为它只要数：ax.hist 每调用一次还要往图里画一遍柱子，而这里用不着图。

分数来自 rng = np.random.default_rng 加一个固定种子：这是一个生成器对象，种子固定，每次运行出来的数就一样。本页产生 numpy 随机数只用这一种写法。integers(0, 101, size=40) 给出 40 个 0 到 100 的整数分（上界 101 本身取不到），末尾再补一个 100，让顶端的边界规则有东西可看。这个种子下五个箱分别是 8、8、10、9、6 个，一共 41 个；换一个种子，计数就会变。
ax.hist 一次调用既数又画，交回三样东西：计数、边界、画出来的柱子。它的计数是浮点数——8.0、8.0、10.0、9.0、6.0——因为同一个函数还能按权重计数或算比例；除此之外与 histogram_counts 一致。画出来是五根肩并肩的柱子，从 0 排到 100，最高的是中间 40 到 60 那一箱。想在窗口里看到这张图，就在 plt.close 之前调用 plt.show()。

lineNotes.en: The extra 100 sits exactly on the top edge, so it tests the one bin that includes its right edge.
lineNotes.zh: 补上的 100 恰好在顶端边界上，专门考那一个含右边界的箱。

lineNotes.en: These counts are floats, unlike the ints histogram_counts returns.
lineNotes.zh: 这里的计数是浮点数，与 histogram_counts 交回的整数不同。

blurb.en: Four shops, four small line graphs in one figure, sharing one x axis, with a title over the whole thing.
blurb.zh: 四家店、一张图里四个小折线图，共用一条横轴，整张图上方再加一个总标题。

en: plt.subplots(2, 2) gives the figure and a grid of axes with 2 rows and 2 columns - a numpy array whose shape is (2, 2). To reach one graph, pick its row first and then its column within that row; row 0 is the top row.

The shop names are taken in the dictionary's order - North, South, East, West - and fill the grid row by row. A row holds two cells, so before cell (r, c) come r whole rows of two names each, then the c names already placed in its own row: North top left, South top right, East bottom left, West bottom right. fig.axes lists the four axes in that same order, so their titles read North, South, East, West.

sharex=True makes all four share one x axis: the same limits everywhere (the demo checks the top-left and bottom-right graphs and finds the same limits), and tick labels only along the bottom row. So only the bottom row, axes[1], gets the axis name Month - the x labels read empty, empty, Month, Month.

figsize=(8, 6) makes the figure 8 inches wide and 6 tall. fig.suptitle writes Sales by shop above the whole figure, while each small graph is titled with its own shop, and tight_layout nudges the four apart so titles and labels do not overlap. The picture: four small line graphs with a dot at each month - West, for example, climbs steadily from 10 to 30.
zh: plt.subplots(2, 2) 给出图和一个 2 行 2 列的坐标系网格——一个 shape 是 (2, 2) 的 numpy 数组。要拿其中一个小图，先取它所在的行，再在那一行里取列；第 0 行在最上面。
店名按字典的顺序取——North、South、East、West——逐行填进网格。一行两格，所以格子 (r, c) 前面有 r 整行、每行两个名字，再加上本行已经填好的 c 个：North 在左上、South 在右上、East 在左下、West 在右下。fig.axes 按同样的顺序列出四个坐标系，所以标题读出来是 North、South、East、West。
sharex=True 让四个小图共用一条横轴：范围处处相同（演示块比了左上和右下两个图，范围一样），刻度文字只出现在最下面一行。所以只给下面一行 axes[1] 写轴名 Month——横轴名读出来是空、空、Month、Month。
figsize=(8, 6) 让整张图宽 8 英寸、高 6 英寸。fig.suptitle 在整张图上方写 Sales by shop，每个小图则用自己的店名当标题；tight_layout 把四个图挪开一点，标题和轴名就不会叠在一起。画出来是四个带圆点的小折线图——比如 West 从 10 一路稳步涨到 30。

lineNotes.en: axes[1] is the bottom row - the only row whose tick labels show when x is shared.
lineNotes.zh: axes[1] 是下面一行——共用横轴时只有这一行显示刻度文字。

lineNotes.en: Spaces the four graphs out so titles and tick labels do not collide.
lineNotes.zh: 把四个图拉开，标题和刻度文字就不会撞在一起。

run.expect:
grid: (2, 2) axes: 4
titles: ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West']
x labels: ['', '', 'Month', 'Month']
suptitle: Sales by shop
same x limits: True
size in inches: [8.0, 6.0]
saved: True

title.en: Styling a Line and Annotating the Peak
title.zh: 线的样式与给峰值加注释

blurb.en: A dashed red line with a dot at each hour, a background grid, and an arrow pointing at the busiest hour.
blurb.zh: 一条带圆点的红色虚线、一层背景网格，再用一支箭头指着人最多的那个小时。

en: Three keywords style the line: linestyle "--" makes it dashed, marker "o" puts a dot on each data point, and color "tab:red" picks the red from matplotlib's standard palette. ax.plot hands back a list of the lines it drew - just one here - and (line,) unpacks that one-element list so the demo can read the style back: --, o and tab:red.
best is the position of the largest count. The most visitors is 34, at hour 11 - position 3 in the list. If the largest value appeared twice, index would give the first one.

ax.annotate writes a note and can draw an arrow to a point. xy is the point the arrow aims at - the peak, (11, 34) - and xytext is where the text sits, one hour to the right and three visitors higher, (12, 37). Both are in the graph's own units. arrowprops is a dictionary describing the arrow; the arrow style -> puts the arrowhead at the xy end. The note reads peak 34.
ax.grid switches on light grid lines behind the data, which make values easier to read off. Pass True: called with no argument it toggles, so a grid that was already on would go off.
The picture: seven hours from 8 to 14 across, the dashed red line rising to its highest point at 11 o'clock, where an arrow from the words peak 34 points at the dot.
zh: 三个关键字定线的样式：linestyle "--" 画成虚线，marker "o" 在每个数据点上放一个圆点，color "tab:red" 取 matplotlib 标准调色板里的红色。ax.plot 交回它画的线组成的列表——这里只有一条——(line,) 把这个只有一项的列表拆开，演示块才能把样式读回来：--、o、tab:red。
best 是最大人数所在的位置。人最多是 34，在 11 点——列表里的第 3 位。如果最大值出现两次，index 给的是第一个。
ax.annotate 写一条注释，还能画一支箭头指向某个点。xy 是箭头指着的点——峰值 (11, 34)；xytext 是文字放的位置，往右一小时、往上三个人，即 (12, 37)。两者都用图本身的单位。arrowprops 是描述箭头的字典；箭头样式 -> 让箭头尖落在 xy 那一头。注释的文字是 peak 34。
ax.grid 在数据后面打开浅色网格线，读数更方便。要传 True：不带实参调用是「切换」，原来已经开着的网格会被关掉。
画出来的样子：横轴是 8 点到 14 点共七个小时，红色虚线在 11 点升到最高，一支箭头从 peak 34 这几个字指向那个点。

lineNotes.en: ax.plot always hands back a list of lines; (line,) insists there is exactly one.
lineNotes.zh: ax.plot 总是交回一个线的列表；(line,) 要求里面恰好只有一条。

lineNotes.en: The arrow's settings as a dictionary; -> puts the head at the point being annotated.
lineNotes.zh: 箭头的设置写成字典；-> 让箭头尖落在被注释的点上。

run.expect:
style: -- o tab:red
note text: peak 34
arrow points at: (11, 34)
text sits at: (12, 37)
has arrow: True
saved: True

blurb.en: A 4 by 3 inch figure saved at 100 dpi is 400 by 300 pixels, at 200 dpi 800 by 600 - and the file name decides PNG, PDF or SVG.
blurb.zh: 4×3 英寸的图按 100 dpi 存是 400×300 像素，按 200 dpi 存是 800×600——存成 PNG、PDF 还是 SVG 由文件名决定。

en: figsize is in inches and dpi is dots (pixels) per inch, so a saved PNG is figsize times dpi pixels. A figure 4 inches wide and 3 tall saved at 100 dpi is 400 by 300 pixels; at 200 dpi it is 800 by 600 - the same picture, drawn sharper, with four times as many pixels.

The dpi given to savefig applies to that one file only; the figure keeps its own setting. save_chart closes each figure as soon as it is saved, which is why no figures are left open after four charts.

The demo checks the arithmetic by reading each PNG back with plt.imread. The array's shape comes as rows, then columns, then colour channels - height first - so the 100 dpi file gives (300, 400, 4); the 4 channels are red, green, blue and alpha (transparency). Swapping to (cols, rows) gives (width, height), and both files match pixel_size exactly.

The file name's ending picks the format: .png is a grid of pixels, while .pdf and .svg are vector formats that store the shapes themselves, so they stay sharp at any size and dpi does not limit them. All three files exist afterwards. The program deliberately does not print file sizes in bytes - those change between library versions.
zh: figsize 以英寸计，dpi 是每英寸多少个点（像素），所以存出来的 PNG 是 figsize 乘 dpi 个像素。宽 4 英寸、高 3 英寸的图按 100 dpi 存是 400×300 像素；按 200 dpi 存是 800×600——画面相同、更清晰，像素多到四倍。
传给 savefig 的 dpi 只管这一个文件，图自己的设置不变。save_chart 每存完一张就关掉它，所以画了四张之后一张打开的图都不剩。
演示块用 plt.imread 把每个 PNG 读回来核对算术。数组的 shape 依次是行数、列数、颜色通道数——高在前——所以 100 dpi 的文件是 (300, 400, 4)；4 个通道是红、绿、蓝和 alpha（透明度）。换成 (cols, rows) 就是 (宽, 高)，两个文件都与 pixel_size 分毫不差。
文件名的后缀决定格式：.png 是像素网格；.pdf 和 .svg 是矢量格式，存的是图形本身，放多大都清晰，dpi 限制不了它们。三个文件事后都在。程序故意不打印文件有多少字节——那个数随库的版本变。

lineNotes.en: One file per dpi, so the two sizes can be compared side by side.
lineNotes.zh: 每个 dpi 一个文件，两种尺寸可以并排比较。

lineNotes.at: print(dpi, "dpi: expected", pixel_size(4, 3, dpi), "got", (cols, rows), "channels", channels)
lineNotes.en: (cols, rows) turns the array's height-first order into the usual (width, height).
lineNotes.zh: (cols, rows) 把数组「高在前」的顺序换成常说的 (宽, 高)。

run.expect:
100 dpi: expected (400, 300) got (400, 300) channels 4
200 dpi: expected (800, 600) got (800, 600) channels 4
chart-100.png True
chart.pdf True
chart.svg True
figures still open: 0

title.en: Plotting a DataFrame onto Your Axes
title.zh: 把 DataFrame 画到你给的坐标系上

blurb.en: A table of boys and girls in three forms draws itself as a grouped bar chart - onto an axes you made, so you stay in charge of the figure.
blurb.zh: 一张三个班男生女生人数的表，自己画成分组柱状图——画在你建好的坐标系上，整张图仍由你掌控。

en: The DataFrame holds three forms, 7A, 7B and 7C, with a boys column (14, 12, 15) and a girls column (13, 16, 11); DataFrames themselves are in 「pandas DataFrames」. to_string can switch the row numbers off, so the table prints without the column of row numbers down the left.

df.plot with kind "bar" and x "form" puts the form names along the x axis, and every other numeric column becomes its own series of bars: boys and girls side by side for each form. The legend takes its names from the column names, boys and girls, and the x axis is named after the column used, form.

The ax argument is the point of this program: without it pandas makes a figure of its own; with it pandas draws onto the axes you made, so you can go on naming the y axis, adding a title and saving through fig as usual. The demo confirms the figure's only axes is the one you passed in.

ax.patches holds all 6 bars, series by series rather than form by form: first the three boys bars (14, 12, 15), then the three girls bars (13, 16, 11). rot=0 keeps the labels 7A, 7B, 7C level - for bar charts pandas turns them on their side by default.
zh: 这张 DataFrame 有三个班 7A、7B、7C，一列 boys（14、12、15）、一列 girls（13、16、11）；DataFrame 本身见「pandas 数据表」。to_string 可以把行号关掉，打印表格时就不带左边那一列行号。
df.plot 用 kind "bar"、x "form"，把班名排在横轴上，其余每一列数字各成一组柱子：每个班 boys 和 girls 并排站。图例的名字取自列名 boys 和 girls，横轴的名字就是用作横轴的那一列 form。
ax 这个实参是本程序的要点：不给它，pandas 自己另建一张图；给了它，pandas 就画在你建好的坐标系上，你照常给纵轴命名、加标题、经过 fig 保存。演示块确认了这张图唯一的坐标系就是你传进去的那个。
ax.patches 里是全部 6 根柱子，按组排而不是按班排：先是 boys 的三根（14、12、15），再是 girls 的三根（13、16、11）。rot=0 让 7A、7B、7C 保持水平——画柱状图时 pandas 缺省把它们转成竖的。

lineNotes.en: True means pandas added no axes of its own - everything went onto ax.
lineNotes.zh: True 说明 pandas 没有自己另加坐标系——全都画在了 ax 上。

lineNotes.en: After df.plot, ax is an ordinary axes again: name it, title it, save it.
lineNotes.zh: df.plot 之后，ax 又是一个普通的坐标系：照样命名、加标题、保存。

run.expect:
form  boys  girls
  7A    14     13
  7B    12     16
  7C    15     11
bars: 6
heights: [14.0, 12.0, 15.0, 13.0, 16.0, 11.0]
x label: form
x ticks: ['7A', '7B', '7C']
legend: ['boys', 'girls']
drew on my axes: True
saved: True
